name: manual_64f76b
claim: MCP daemon startup: after launching a background daemon (nohup, detached), probe the Unix socket in a loop with 0.1s sleeps and a hard ceiling (50 iterations = 5s). Fail with a JSON-RPC error response to stderr if the socket never becomes connectable. Do not block stdin or use sleep chains.

decisions.notes: exa-mcp-wrapper.sh startup pattern. Python socket probe with settimeout(1) is reliable across macOS. 2026-07-04.
